next_minimal_correction_gate.gate_name: B1 precondition-only frame-scale-z and map-readiness correction gate
allowed_actions: Start only real source replay, IMU/state replay, FAST-LIO, and EGO input subscriptions.
Reuse the 019 runner discipline: wait for Livox, start/probe IMU, probe Livox plus IMU acceptance, then start FAST-LIO.
Keep replay bounded so LiDAR does not wrap during FAST-LIO initialization and the first odometry/map-readiness checks.
Capture first and last /Odometry, /cloud_registered, /tf or /tf_static if available, topic info, rates, and process cleanup.
Capture /grid_map/occupancy and /grid_map/occupancy_inflate width before any goal.
hard_stop_conditions: Stop before goal if /Odometry absolute coordinates exceed the configured bound or start is outside the static EGO map envelope.
Stop before goal if the effective EGO goal would be outside map bounds or farther than the configured short-goal limit.
Stop before goal if occupancy or inflated occupancy samples remain width=0.
Stop and write blocker if FAST-LIO logs lidar loop back clear-buffer or persistent No Effective Points before a bounded odometry sample.
